title: Clay Classes with Gas Reduction and Raku Firings
source_quote: your work will be finished in a high-fire gas reduction or raku kiln. Spacious and well-lit, our clay studios include numerous wheels and hand-building areas

cost_text: Tuition covers glaze materials and kiln firing
